boundary.policy: Hold only unreviewed restore userspace task release

limitations: Progress depends on native earlier calls completing; broader objectives do not repair the current read wait
Success checkpoints return to native control flow; native errors remain observable and are not overridden
A02E is the first nonzero stage for the attempt; A032 is raw native return and not always errno
Video and stable photo can omit transient checkpoints; cumulative tiles are not complete ordering or execution counts
Reaching 239 is a controlled Restore task release boundary, not EL0 execution
